chunks.text: Ur Regional Archaeology Project: the archive of  cuneiform tablets from Tell Khaiber

This website is the online complement to  Eleanor Robson  [https://www.ucl.ac.uk/history/people/academic-staff/professor-eleanor-robson] 's chapter, "The archive", in Jane Moon (ed.),  Tell Khaiber: A Fortified Centre of the First Sealand Dynasty , Ludlow: Moonrise Press, 2023.     It contains an  open-access edition and translation  [http://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/urap/corpus]  of all 145 cuneiform texts and other inscribed artefacts found at Tell Khaiber by the  Ur Regional Archaeology Project  [http://www.urarchaeology.org] , plus glossaries of all  Akkadian  [http://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/urap/akk-x-oldbab]  and  Sumerian  [http://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/urap/sux]  words, and linked lists of all the  people, gods and places  [http://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/urap/qpn]  named in the archive.    Photographs of the tablets are currently being processed by the CDLI team and will be linked to this site as soon as they are available.
